name: Kyopulo (Eggplant with Peppers and Tomatoes)
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Roast the aubergines and peppers on a hot plate. Remove the skins, and cut into small pieces.
Add the tomatoes, then the crushed garlic.
Mix with a wooden spoon, then add oil, vinegar, and salt to taste. Beat together well.
Pour into a plate and top with finely chopped parsley.

culture.text: Kyopulo or kyopolou is a type of Bulgarian relish or spread, made of eggplant, peppers, and tomatoes.
